_: Read by release.mjs. Nothing secret goes in here: the API key is the NEXUS_API_KEY environment variable.
_mod_id: The number in your own mod's URL, https://www.nexusmods.com/fieldsofmistria/mods/<this>. Fill it in once.
_file_name: The name of the file on the Nexus page. Matched exactly to decide new-version vs new-file, so changing it creates a second download rather than updating the first. Max 50 chars, letters digits space _ ' ( ) . - only.
_update_mod_version: Whether uploading also bumps the version shown at the top of the mod page.
_archive_existing_file: Whether the previous version moves to the archived files list instead of staying visible.
